title: The Rotting Pier
text: A pier juts into the black water, rotten planks over a drop into nothing. A boat is tied at the far end, bumping gently against the pilings. Something below the water bumps back.

options.label: Walk the rotten planks carefully, without looking down.

outcomes.text: You reach the boat, and it is a short way across the black water.
A plank gives and a leg goes through. Something below brushes it.

options.label: The lightest-laden goes first and tests each plank for the rest.

outcomes.text: They find every bad plank, and everyone gets across.

options.label: Swim for the boat, trusting the black water to be only water.

outcomes.text: Something in the water likes swimmers.
